Settings

3.0.0-beta.8

REST API

Drive Deltabadger from your own scripts.

URL
localhost:3000/api/v1
Token
[redacted]
Regenerate

Regenerate the token? Any scripts using the current one will stop working until you update them.

Docs
deltabadger-api.md

Tool permissions

What may be done over MCP and over the REST API. The switch beside a group name turns the whole group on or off.

Read
List bots
View all DCA bots and their status
Bot details
View detailed bot info and performance
List exchanges
View connected exchanges
Exchange balances
Fetch live balances from an exchange
Portfolio summary
View global P/L and bot breakdown
List transactions
View recent trades
List open orders
View currently open (unfilled) orders
List rules
View withdrawal rules and their settings
List indices
View indices an index bot can track
Control
Create bot
Create a new DCA bot
Start bot
Start a stopped bot
Stop bot
Stop a running bot
Update bots
Change amount or label on a stopped bot
Start rule
Start a stopped rule
Stop rule
Stop an active rule
Update rules
Change settings on a stopped rule
Create rule
Create a withdrawal rule to an allow-listed address
Delete rule
Delete a stopped withdrawal rule
Create index bot
Create and start an index DCA bot
Create signal bot
Create and start a signal bot that trades one pair on demand
Delete bot
Delete a bot, running or not; its schedule is cancelled
Archive bot
Stop a bot and hide it from the dashboard
Reactivate bot
Bring an archived bot back
Sync tracker
Pull new transactions and balances from exchanges
Mark transfer
Link or unlink a withdrawal with its deposit
State a price
Set the USD price of a transaction the venue did not value
Trade
Market buy
Execute a market buy order
Market sell
Execute a market sell order
Limit buy
Place a limit buy order at a specific price
Limit sell
Place a limit sell order at a specific price
Cancel order
Cancel an open order
Sell exited holding
Sell a holding an index or basket bot has dropped
Answer redeploy offer
Accept or decline redeploying sale proceeds
Tax & Reporting
Tax jurisdictions
View supported countries and tax methods
Generate tax report
Start background tax report generation
Tax report status
Check if a tax report is ready
Download tax report
Retrieve generated tax report CSV
Export transactions CSV
Export account transactions as CSV
Account transactions
View tracker transactions with filters
